title: Orchestration decision
description: The routing decision for one revision, at examples/<project>/revisions/<id>/orchestration-decision.json. Records what the user asked for, which pipeline scope that maps to, and therefore which stages run — so a later stage can read the routing instead of re-deriving it from prose. orchestration-decision.md stays the human rendering. The stage and scope vocabularies come from config/pipeline.json, which remains the routing source of truth; this file records the choice, not the rules.

schemaVersion.description: On-disk contract version for this artifact.

intent.description: Task type detected from the user gesture, per skills/workflows/revise-template/SKILL.md § Task type detection (New generation, Revision, Undo last change, Revert to approved, Selective rollback, Approval, Diff / review, Revision summary).

scope.description: Pipeline scope chosen for this revision. Matches the scope keys in config/pipeline.json — including the inferred "new", which routes a first revision through the full chain and is never written into revision.json.

parentRevision.description: Revision this one is based on; null for the first revision in a chain.

stages.description: Ordered stage ids that will run, copied from the scope's entry in config/pipeline.json. Recorded so the artifact is self-contained for audit; the config is still what decides.

gate.description: The gate this scope ends on, from config/pipeline.json → gates.

affectedComponents.description: Named private render methods this revision is expected to touch. Feeds the region-aware gate and the selective rollback model.

detectedGesture.description: The user gesture verbatim, or a one-line summary of it.

rationale.description: Why this scope and not the neighbouring one — the sentence that would otherwise be lost when the routing is questioned later.

clarifyingQuestion.description: Present when the gesture was ambiguous. The orchestrator asks exactly ONE question and does not open a revision until it is answered.

skippedStages.description: Stages the short scope deliberately skips, recorded so "why did nobody run the Visual Analyzer" has an answer in the artifact.

allOf.description: A revision-producing intent must name a scope that produces a render; the bookkeeping intents (approval, undo, review) may reuse the parent's.
